Accept loopback being down

Map them beneath a dedicated runtime root
Infer targets from RELEASE_SANDBOX_INTERPRETER

Find an interpreter within SANDBOX_RUNTIME_PATHS
Use a fixed python command inside the sandbox

Continuously measure the host directory and kill on excess

open_points.subject: execute_function exchange mount location
open_points.text: "one fresh private exchange directory bound read-write"
open_points.question: What path names the exchange directory inside the sandbox, and what files or subdirectories form its protocol?

Expose the host temporary path unchanged

open_points.subject: execute_function trusted channel
open_points.text: "each trap first writes its hit to a channel to the parent that the code cannot unsend"

Append-only files in the writable exchange directory

Trust the runner's in-process objects

Files written atomically in the exchange directory

open_points.text: "replace every entry point named by the imported SANDBOX_TRAPPED_FUNCTIONS constant ... every method of the class named by the imported SANDBOX_TRAPPED_CLASS constant"

Names refer to builtins only
Resolve dotted names dynamically across imported standard-library modules

open_points.subject: execute_function trap exceptions

Preserve the original API's likely exception type

The API's relevant argument is absent
Absent or None, as for the unseeded constructor

open_points.text: "when constructed without a seed or with None, and that class's seed method when called on an instance without a seed or with None"

Inspect the actual callable signature
Trap every false-like value

open_points.subject: execute_function trap persistence

Patch only the initially imported objects
Rely solely on the audit hook for indirect access

open_points.subject: execute_function audit event policy
open_points.text: "install an audit hook that raises on socket, subprocess and ctypes use"
open_points.question: Which exact Python audit event names and prefixes constitute socket, subprocess, ctypes, os.system, posix_spawn, exec-family, fork, and thread-start use?

Reject events by string prefix

open_points.text: "raises ... on opening any path outside the exchange directory and the read-only runtime"

Compare lexical path prefixes
Deny every non-string or non-absolute path

open_points.subject: execute_function access to proc and dev
open_points.text: "bubblewrap's own fresh proc and minimal dev mounts" and "opening any path outside the exchange directory and the read-only runtime"

Deny untrusted opens under both while allowing runner internals
